alex: PHOENIX onboarding request - new checkpoint `phoenix-7b` landed in model-hub. Need perf + quant bring-up. Scope:
- Quant smoke: int8 (GPTQ) then int4 (AWQ) if feasible
- Context sweeps: 2048 / 8192 / 16384
- Batch profiles: batch=1,4,8,16
- Targets: p50 < 120ms @ batch=1 seq=512; throughput goal ~22k tok/s @ batch=8 seq=512 (ballpark)
- Quality: win-rate vs `stable-7b` on `prod-qa-v2` eval set + toxicity check
Who can take the bench + quality harness?

maya: I can take perf runs. Which quant path first? GPTQ or AWQ? Also share exact eval prompts.

alex: start GPTQ int8 path (onnx) then AWQ int4 as follow-up if int8 looks OK. Eval set: `gs://redwood-eval/prod-qa-v2/` (read-only). Use seq=512 and seq=2048 for latency baselines. Quick smoke command to run locally/staging:
```
bench_tool --model phoenix-7b --quant gptq-int8 --ctx 512 --batch 1 --runs 200 --output ./artifacts/phoenix_smoke.json
```
Include token-level latency and flame logs.

jin: staging infra note - I reserved two A100-80GB nodes for the smoke and ctx-8k sweep. Please schedule heavy runs off-peak, I prefer 01:00-05:00 PT windows. Also FYI one staging host has an older cuda/kernels mismatch, will patch tonight.

maya: scheduling smoke tonight 01:30 PT. Full ctx sweep (2k/8k/16k) tomorrow 03:00 PT. Will run batch profiles during sweep. If 16k OOMs, will try kv-slicing + lower batch. I'll post a condensed results summary in this thread.

perf-bot: CI triggered: bench/phoenix-7b/gptq-int8/smoke (run_id: 20260318-01). Logs: https://ci.redwood/bench/20260318-01

sam: adding quality harness: I'll run win-rate pairwise eval vs `stable-7b` and also run the detox scan. Output should be a small CSV with columns: prompt_id, winner, ll_diff, toxic_flag. Hooking it into the bench pipeline so we get automated deltas.

maya: First smoke results (condensed):
- env: 2xA100-80GB, gptq-int8
- seq=512 batch=1: p50=98ms, p95=220ms, throughput=5.4 tok/s (per GPU)
- seq=512 batch=8: p50=48ms (amortized), throughput=21.6 tok/s (per GPU)
- seq=2048 batch=1: p50=420ms, OOM on one node until kv-slice enabled
- seq=8192 batch=1 (kv-slice): p50=1650ms, throughput drops significantly
- gptq-int8 vs stable-7b win-rate: phoenix wins 52% (small improvement)
- awq-int4 quick smoke (single-GPU): quality drop on long-context prompts, win-rate 39% vs stable-7b and higher hallucination on instruction-following tests
Notes: int8 path looks promising for latency/throughput; int4 needs deeper quality debugging especially for ctx>=8k. Full artifact: s3://redwood-bench/phoenix/20260318/artifacts.tar.gz

alex: thanks. The int4 regression on long-context is concerning. Assign to @maya + @sam to triage root cause (quant config vs kv-cache corruption). Please open ENG-ML ticket and link artifacts. Also let's not promote int4 to catalog until we have fixes.

jin: infra update - patched kernel mismatch and reprovisioned one host with 160GB host memory for 16k runs. Dropped in a larger NVME for swap traces if needed. Let me know when you want the 16k pass rerun.

perf-bot: CI finished: bench/phoenix-7b/gptq-int8/full-sweep. Artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood/bench/artifacts/20260318-01 (sha: a7c3f9).

sam: I'll run the AWQ int4 diagnostic: comparing layerwise quant error and kv-cache drift on long sequences. Plan:
1) per-layer calibration table (100 prompts)
2) replay kv-cache with instrumented checksums
3) run eval harness and produce win-rate + ll-deltas
I'll post findings by EOD tomorrow.

alex: appreciated. Summary action items: 
- maya: finish full ctx & batch profiles, upload artifacts (due TOM).
- sam: int4 diagnostics + quality report (due TOM EOD).
- jin: hold staging nodes until TOM afternoon and share reservation window.
- alex: create ENG-ML-4023 (canary + block int4 catalog).

Please keep comments short in-thread; we can spin a doc for deep analysis after the diagnostic results.
